close_reason: Added isUnread convention doc to MailBackend module: isUnread = !seen && !draft, drafts never count as unread.
description: jmapio/jmap-js (spec authors' reference impl) defines isUnread = NOT keywords.$seen AND NOT keywords.$draft. Draft messages never count as unread in mailbox unread counts. This is not explicitly stated in RFC 8621 text but is the authoritative implementation behavior. Add a doc comment to the MailBackend trait or the unread count fields in Mailbox to codify this. Source: ~/GIT/jmap-js/source/mail/Message.js lines 803-805.
